entry.name: rnbo_inport
entry.description: Send messages into RNBO. Inport objects create user-defined message tags which allow for control of the RNBO patcher without exposing an attribute. The inport can be accessed by sending messages in the format message <inport-tag> <value-list> .

arguments.name: tag
arguments.description: A symbol, typed into the object box, defines a tag for messages sent into RNBO via inport. This tag cannot be a number.
